items.title: What the ticket says

props.text: #178: afkv2: propose-solution page takes the grill's living page and visual design view

## Want

Bring the page-communication changes of the requirements grill to `/afkv2:propose-solution`.

- Same principle as the requirements grill: the agents work on their own first, come up with a complete design and solution (a multi-provider pattern where it applies), then present it on the lavish page.
- More visualization: architecture, flows, modules, key logic.
- Structure: high level first, then progressive disclosure of lower-level detail. Critical parts get more attention, for example a dedicated section.
- Each design decision is explained: it cites the requirements and constraints that lead to it (the ADRs) and gives a brief of the alternatives, so the developer knows them.
- After sign-off: suggest an estimated effort in dev days, fully executed by agents. Not every repository has an effort field.
- Page layout: the always-current cards (living sections), with the notes and response cards on top, stacking up over the rounds.
- Also carry over the other recent grill page enhancements.

- #175: page format 2, living sections with a change list per round, stories, examples, questions for others, take-over, `stale` / `changed` end check.
- #172: page-owned terms and exact-id tips.
- #171: use-lavish skill, page format 1, charts, diagram text, code and diff components.
- #167: one note per annotation, one tab across rounds.
- #177 (open): rename grill to grill-requirements.

sections.title: Why the design page must change

props.text:
4 pains, accepted in round 1:

- **Lost picture:** you see one layer's questions at a time, so the whole design is never in view at once.
- **Hidden reasons:** a decision shows little of the requirement that drove it or the options it beat.
